package courseplan

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain/repository"
)

func TestCreateEnforcesCallerLearningPathIntentIdentity(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Date(2026, 9, 4, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	pathID := "77777777-7777-4777-8777-777777777777"
	base := CreateInput{
		StudentID: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", IdempotencyKey: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
		GoalCode: "go.backend", Intent: domain.PlanningIntent{
			Source: domain.PlanningSourceStudent, Reason: domain.PlanningReasonInitial, DesiredOutcome: "Build a Go API",
		},
	}
	for _, testCase := range []struct {
		name       string
		input      CreateInput
		wantErr    bool
		wantPathID string
	}{
		{name: "initial allocates later", input: base},
		{name: "initial caller path rejected", input: withCreatePath(base, pathID), wantErr: true},
		{name: "replan requires path", input: withCreateReason(base, domain.PlanningReasonReplan), wantErr: true},
		{name: "replan exact path", input: withCreatePath(withCreateReason(base, domain.PlanningReasonReplan), pathID), wantPathID: pathID},
	} {
		t.Run(testCase.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			repository := &createRequestRepository{}
			useCase := Create{Requests: repository, IDs: fixedIDs{value: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333"}, Clock: fixedClock{value: now}}
			result, _, err := useCase.Handle(context.Background(), testCase.input)
			if testCase.wantErr {
				if !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrValidation) || repository.calls != 0 {
					t.Fatalf("expected boundary validation without persistence, err=%v calls=%d", err, repository.calls)
				}
				return
			}
			if err != nil || result.LearningPathID != testCase.wantPathID || repository.calls != 1 {
				t.Fatalf("unexpected create result=%#v err=%v calls=%d", result, err, repository.calls)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestCreateHashKeepsInitialCompatibilityAndScopesReplanByPath(t *testing.T) {
	intent := domain.PlanningIntent{
		Source: domain.PlanningSourceStudent, Reason: domain.PlanningReasonInitial, DesiredOutcome: "Build a Go API",
		Constraints: domain.PlanningConstraints{}, AuditRefs: domain.PlanningAuditRefs{},
	}
	initialHash, err := hashCreateInput("go.backend", "", intent)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	legacyPayload, err := json.Marshal(struct {
		GoalCode string                `json:"goal_code"`
		Intent   domain.PlanningIntent `json:"intent"`
	}{GoalCode: "go.backend", Intent: intent})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	legacyDigest := sha256.Sum256(legacyPayload)
	if initialHash != hex.EncodeToString(legacyDigest[:]) {
		t.Fatalf("initial request hash lost compatibility: got=%s want=%s", initialHash, hex.EncodeToString(legacyDigest[:]))
	}

	intent.Reason = domain.PlanningReasonReplan
	first, err := hashCreateInput("go.backend", "77777777-7777-4777-8777-777777777777", intent)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	second, err := hashCreateInput("go.backend", "88888888-8888-4888-8888-888888888888", intent)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if first == second || first == initialHash || second == initialHash {
		t.Fatalf("request hashes do not bind exact path: initial=%s first=%s second=%s", initialHash, first, second)
	}
}

func TestDiagnosticPlanLinkIsTeacherInitialOnlyAndHashesSeparately(t *testing.T) {
	base := CreateInput{StudentID: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", IdempotencyKey: "22222222-2222-4222-2222-222222222222", GoalCode: "go.backend", DiagnosticPlanID: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333", Intent: domain.PlanningIntent{Source: domain.PlanningSourceTeacher, Reason: domain.PlanningReasonInitial, DesiredOutcome: "go"}}
	for _, in := range []CreateInput{{DiagnosticPlanID: "not-a-uuid", StudentID: base.StudentID, IdempotencyKey: base.IdempotencyKey, GoalCode: base.GoalCode, Intent: base.Intent}, {DiagnosticPlanID: base.DiagnosticPlanID, StudentID: base.StudentID, IdempotencyKey: base.IdempotencyKey, GoalCode: base.GoalCode, Intent: domain.PlanningIntent{Source: domain.PlanningSourceStudent, Reason: domain.PlanningReasonInitial, DesiredOutcome: "go"}}} {
		if _, _, err := (Create{Requests: &createRequestRepository{}, IDs: fixedIDs{value: "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444"}, Clock: fixedClock{value: time.Now()}}).Handle(context.Background(), in); !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrValidation) {
			t.Fatalf("invalid link=%v", err)
		}
	}
	a, _ := hashCreateInputWithDiagnostic(base.GoalCode, "", base.DiagnosticPlanID, base.Intent)
	b, _ := hashCreateInputWithDiagnostic(base.GoalCode, "", "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444", base.Intent)
	legacy, _ := hashCreateInputWithDiagnostic(base.GoalCode, "", "", base.Intent)
	if a == b || a == legacy {
		t.Fatalf("diagnostic hash not bound %s %s %s", a, b, legacy)
	}
}

func withCreateReason(input CreateInput, reason domain.PlanningReason) CreateInput {
	input.Intent.Reason = reason
	return input
}

func withCreatePath(input CreateInput, pathID string) CreateInput {
	input.LearningPathID = pathID
	return input
}

type createRequestRepository struct {
	repository.CoursePlanRepository
	calls int
}

func (repository *createRequestRepository) CreateOrGet(
	_ context.Context,
	request domain.CoursePlanRequest,
) (domain.CoursePlanRequest, bool, error) {
	repository.calls++
	return request, true, nil
}
